s: Din hattoeh biqriat shema ubo d' seipim: qeraah lemaprea — lo yatza, shenneemar: "vehayu" — bahavayatan yehu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beseder happesuqim, abal im hiqdim parasha lachabertah ap al pi sheeno rashshay — yatza, lepi sheenah semuka lah battora:

Qara parasha vetaa bah, im yodea hekan taa, kegon sheqqara kol happarasha vedilleg pasuq echad baemtza — chozer lerosh oto happasuq vegomer happarasha, sheim yiqra happasuq bammaqom shennizkar nimtza qoreah lemaprea (vaapillu dilleg teba achat o ot achat, o sheshshinna nequdda achat al derek sheyyitbaer besiman qm"b — tzarik lachazor lerosh happasuq shettaa bo). Veim eno yodea hekan taa — tzarik lachazor lerosh happasuq mimmaqom shemmistappeq bo betaut. Kegon, im yadua lo sheamar pasuq "shema" bekavvana — chozer li"veahabta", veim eno yodea sheamar "shema" bekavvana — chozer li"shema":
Taa ben parasha leparasha, shehu yodea shessiyyem parasha veeno yodea im rishona veim sheniyya — chozer lesiyyum parasha rishona veyatchil "vehaya im shamoa":

Haya omed be"uketabtam", veeno yodea im be"uketabtam" shebbeparasha rishona im be"uketabtam" shebbeparasha sheniyya — chozer le"uketabtam" shebbeparasha rishona. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello hitchil "lemaan yirbu yemekem", abal im hitchil "lemaan yirbu yemekem" — en lo lachush shemma hitchil ken achar "uketabtam" shebbarishona, lepi shemmin hassetam qara kepi regiluto shehurgal shello lomar "lemaan yirbu" ad siyyum parasha sheniyya. Umikkol shekken im matza atzmo beteba acheret beemtza parasha — chazaqa sheamar kol mah shellemala mimmenna:
